name: The School Administrator
source:
A religious fundamentalist, he is ill at ease in this liberal ivory tower. Strongly rooted in the local church, he views the wayward students at this school with disdain bordering on disgust. Given the chance, he’ll show you the path to righteousness. He may even help you with your grades, if you are willing to pay one Hell of a price!

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
